title: Job 22
paragraphs: ¹ Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said, ² Can a man be of any use to God? Can even the wisest person benefit him? ³ Does it please the Almighty when you are righteous? Does he gain anything if you make your ways blameless? ⁴ Is it out of reverence for you that he rebukes you and enters into judgment with you? ⁵ Is it not because your wickedness is great and your sins have no end?

⁶ For you have taken pledges from your brothers without cause and left the naked stripped of their clothing. ⁷ You gave no water to the weary and withheld food from the hungry. ⁸ You handed the land over to the powerful and let the favored dwell in it. ⁹ You sent widows away empty-handed and crushed the arms of orphans. ¹⁰ That is why snares surround you, why sudden terror overwhelms you,

¹¹ why you cannot see through the darkness, and why a flood of water engulfs you. ¹² Is not God high in the heavens? See how lofty are the highest stars! ¹³ Yet you say, 'What does God know? Can he see through the thick darkness to judge? ¹⁴ Clouds are a curtain to him; he cannot see as he walks along the vault of heaven.' ¹⁵ Will you keep to the ancient path that the wicked have walked?

¹⁶ They were snatched away before their time, their foundations swept away by a flood. ¹⁷ They said to God, 'Leave us alone! What can the Almighty do to us?' ¹⁸ Yet it was he who filled their houses with good things — but I want nothing to do with the counsel of the wicked. ¹⁹ The righteous see their ruin and rejoice; the innocent mock them: ²⁰ 'Surely our enemies are destroyed, and fire has consumed what they left behind.'

²¹ Submit to God and be at peace with him; in this way prosperity will come to you. ²² Accept instruction from his mouth and store up his words in your heart. ²³ If you return to the Almighty, you will be restored — if you remove wickedness far from your tent. ²⁴ Throw your gold into the dust, your finest gold among the rocks of the ravines, ²⁵ and the Almighty himself will be your gold, your choicest silver.

²⁶ Then you will find your delight in the Almighty and lift up your face to God. ²⁷ You will pray to him and he will hear you, and you will fulfill your vows to him. ²⁸ Whatever you decide will be done, and light will shine on your ways. ²⁹ When others are brought low, you will say, 'Lift them up!' and God will save the downcast. ³⁰ He will deliver even the guilty — he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.
